bolt the door verb

also bolt, lock, shoot the bolt

classical

Traupman 122
Ter.
Liv.

obserō, obserāre

verb, first conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

bolt, lock

Other words

  • pessulum ōstiō obdere — shoot the bolt

    also used · classical · Ter. Eun. 3.5.55, as cited by L&S s.v. pessulus

Examples

  • Pater, jānuā obserātā, antequam lūmen exstingueret, in ephēmeride scrīpsit

    Dad bolted the door and, before turning off the light, wrote in his diaryLibellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

See also bolt, lock, unlock, door.
